Senior.title: Ask a Senior
Senior.intro: Questions answered by verified current students of this programme. Every question is checked by a moderator before it appears.
Senior.demoBanner: Demo content: these are sample threads showing how Ask a Senior will work. They are not real students or real answers.
Senior.question: Your question
Senior.questionHint: One question at a time. Don't include phone numbers, emails or links — answers appear here, publicly.
Senior.contact: Please remove phone numbers, emails or links — they can't be published.
Senior.savedNote: Demo: your question is saved only in this browser and isn't sent anywhere yet.
Senior.rule2: Questions about other people, or anything abusive
Senior.rule3: Fee or seat negotiation — those go to admissions
Senior.empty: No questions yet. Be the first to ask.

Assistant.title: Ask SRM
Assistant.subtitle: Answers come from SRM's published information — no AI guesses.
Assistant.error: Something went wrong. Please try again, or call admissions.
Assistant.hello: Hi! I can help with programmes, admissions, campuses, rankings, hostels and more. What would you like to know?
Assistant.whichProgramme: That depends on the programme. Which one are you interested in? For example: “fees for BDS”.
Assistant.feesUnknown: Fees for this programme aren't published on this site yet. Admissions can give you the exact 2026–27 amount, including hostel.
Assistant.applyText: Applications are made on SRM's official portal. You can also send an enquiry and an admissions counsellor will get back to you.
Assistant.locationAsk: SRMIST has six campuses. Which one? Try “where is Vadapalani campus?” — or see them all on the map.
Assistant.allCampuses: See all campuses on the map
Assistant.placementsNote: These are university-wide figures for all programmes ({offers} offers), not for one programme.
Assistant.hostelText: SRM publishes its hostel information on its official website. For room types, fees and availability, admissions can help.
Assistant.safetyText: SRMIST has an anti-ragging committee and publishes its campus safety and grievance information here:
Assistant.scholarshipText: Scholarship details aren't published on this site yet. Admissions can tell you what's available for your programme.
Assistant.programmesText: There are {programmes} programmes across {colleges} colleges. Tell me what you enjoy — like “robots”, “law” or “becoming a doctor” — and I'll suggest some.
Assistant.internationalText: International applicants have a dedicated admissions page:
Assistant.tourText: Take SRM's 360° virtual tour of the Kattankulathur campus, or explore every campus on the map.
Assistant.programmeMatches: These programmes match what you said — open one for fees, eligibility and more:
Assistant.notSure: I don't have a verified answer for that yet. Rather than guess, here's how to reach a person:
Assistant.sDoctor: I want to become a doctor
